⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside. 3. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. One-pan Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta🔥483 cals 53g protein 13g fat 39g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 servings 2.5 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced 10 oz uncooked pasta (rigatoni) 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1/2 an orange bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp minced garlic 3 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block 1/3 fat cream cheese or 8 oz 50g grated Parmesan Homemade Cajun Seasoning: 2 tsp smoked paprika 2 tsp garlic powder 1½ tsp onion powder 1 tsp dried oregano 1 tsp dried thyme 1 tsp black pepper ½–1 tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp salt Directions: 1. Mix together all of your Cajun seasoning. 2. Season the diced chicken generously with about ⅔ of the seasoning. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 3–4 minutes until browned on the outside but not completely cooked through. 4. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for another 2–3 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. 5. Add the uncooked pasta, chicken broth and remaining Cajun seasoning. Stir everything together and bring to a gentle boil. 6. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cream cheese and Parmesan until everything comes together into a thick, creamy Cajun sauce. 9. Let it sit for 2–3 minutes to thicken, divide into 6 containers and you’ve got meal prep for the week! Follow for more #mealprep #highprotein #cajunchicken #chickenpasta #fatlossrecipes

Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. Chipotle Honey Chicken with Rice 🌶️🍯🍗 Ingredients: Chicken breast 🍗 Chipotle peppers in adobo sauce 🌶️ Honey 🍯 Salt Black pepper Paprika Lime juice 🍋‍🟩 Mixed bell peppers 🫑 Onion 🧅 Cooked rice 🍚 How to make: Add chipotle peppers, honey, salt, black pepper, paprika, and lime juice to a blender and blend into a smooth paste. Coat the chicken breast well with the chipotle-honey paste and let it marinate for a little while. Heat a pan and cook the marinated chicken until fully cooked and nicely browned. In the same pan, add sliced mixed bell peppers and onion. Add a little of the same chipotle-honey paste and sauté until the veggies are slightly tender but still have a little crunch. Serve the chicken and veggies with warm rice. 🍚🔥 Sweet, smoky, spicy & super easy! 🤌🏽🌶️

Street Corn Chicken Bowls🍗🌽🍚 Absolutely phenomenal flavors for how easy it is to make. Another game changing meal prep recipe, all done in one sheet pan, minimal effort for maximum taste🤤🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 637 Calories | 57g Protein | 55g Carbs | 21g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Mexican Grilled Chicken - 1300g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 1.5 Tsp Chilli Powder - 6 Tsp (30g) Olive Oil Creamy Street Corn Salad - 600g Canned Sweet Corn, drained - 200g Red Onion, chopped - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Paprika - 150g Red Bell Pepper, chopped - 80-100g Jalapeño, chopped - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 70-100g Low Fat Feta Cheese - 2 Tbsp Fresh Coriander/Cilantro, finely chopped - 2-3 Tsp Tajin Seasoning Coriander Lime Rice - 250g Uncooked Basmati Rice - Big Handful Coriander, finely chopped - Squeeze of Lime Juice - Pinch of Salt to taste 👨‍🍳Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from boneless chicken thighs. Add to bowl with Mexican seasoning, lime juice and olive oil. Mix well to marinate. 2. Add washed uncooked rice to a pot of water, bring to a boil then simmer on low heat until fully cooked. Once cooked, let it cool, add chopped corianderwith lime juice and pinch of salt. Mix well then set aside. 3. Get a large lined sheet pan, spread marinated chicken evenly then oven bake for 23 mins at 200C/390F and broil for 5-6 mins until golden brown, charred and juicy.  4. Remove chicken from pan, add sweetcorn, red onion, garlic powder and paprika. Mix in all the chicken juices then flatten evenly. Oven roast for just 15 mins until crispy. 5. Add roasted corn to a large mixing bowl, with all listed ingredients then mix well until creamy and delicious. 6. Chop the chicken into cubes, serve with cilantro lime rice and street corn salad and ENJOY! . . . #streetcorn #chickenrecipe #mealprep #healthyrecipes #weightloss

Ingredients: -3 lbs of chicken breast, diced into 1”x1” pieces  -3 tbs neutral oil, plus more for cooking -1 small can of chipotle peppers in adobo sauce  -1 tbs garlic powder  -1 tbs onion powder  -1 tbs smoked paprika  -1 tbs ground cumin  -2 tsp dried oregano  -2 tsp salt -2 tsp pepper Instructions: -add chicken into a large bowl; add 3 tbs of neutral (avocado, canola, vegetable) oil and mix in the seasonings listed above  -add in one small can of chipotle peppers in adobo sauce and mix well; avoid bursting open the peppers to prevent the chicken from being too spicy  -cover the bowl with a lid and marinade in the fridge for at least two hours up to overnight  -allow the bowl to sit at room temp for 20 minutes before cooking  -set a nonstick pan or skillet on medium-high heat and add 3 tbs of neutral oil -add some of the chicken to the pan, ensuring that the pieces are spaced apart evenly  -cook one side of the chicken until the edges turn white, about 2-3 minutes  -flip the pieces of chicken over and cook for another 2 minutes  -transfer the cooked chicken onto a baking sheet to rest  -add more oil to the pan and cook the rest of the chicken in batches  -prepare the meal prep containers and add desired sides and pairings  -divide the chicken equally into each meal container -store in the fridge for up to four days or in the freezer for up to six months -enjoy!  #chipotle #chicken #mealprep #chickenrecipes #highprotein
